PROJECT / 01 — Multilingual NLP

RAHATAI

A crisis intelligence platform that brings classification, entity extraction, summarization, and grounded question answering into one workflow.

View source on GitHub ↗
Focus
Multilingual NLP
Stack
Python · PyTorch · Transformers · scikit-learn · RAG
Format
Project case study
The work

From problem to system.

The problem

During a crisis, useful information can be scattered across languages and long, unstructured reports. RAHATAI explores how a single system can help make those reports easier to triage and understand.

The approach

The pipeline combines several NLP tasks: it classifies crisis text, extracts named entities, summarizes longer material, and answers questions using retrieval over official documents. The repository also describes misinformation detection and Whisper-based voice input.

01
Classify

Compare Transformer and classical or neural classifiers for crisis text.

02
Extract and summarize

Identify entities and condense long reports with a BART summarization stage.

03
Ground answers

Use retrieved official documents as context for question answering, with source attributions in the interface.

This is a research-oriented local application. The repository describes model setup and local execution; it does not present a public hosted demo or verified production usage.
